note: The burrow's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Blackburrow): Elder Grawl, just east of the fire pit, gives the first two, Packleader Varg beside him the three hunts; Hidescraper Yipp, a few steps south by the tents, is the outfitter; Coachman Skulk keeps the stable on the road outside the south-east gate (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the hill badgers (the hill to the north-west), the ridge vipers (the scrub to the south) and the wolf Greymuzzle (alone on the rise far to the north-east) are placed for these quests.

L1.name: A Pup's Pack Collar
offer: Come closer, pup. Let me smell you. Hrrn. Milk and ashes. You are ours, then. But the guards cannot smell as I can, and they bite what they do not know.
Every pup wears the pack collar. Hidescraper Yipp cuts them, a few steps south of here, by the tents.
Will you fetch your collar and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then stay by the fire, pup, where the guards can see you.
L1.started: South, by the tents. Follow the smell of wet hide.

piece.name: pup's pack collar
piece.description: A collar of badger hide, branded with the mark of Blackburrow. Every pup of the pack wears one.

fetch.journal: Ask Hidescraper Yipp, a few steps south of Elder Grawl, for a pup's pack collar.
fetch.says: Grawl's new pup? Chin up. Badger hide, the pack's brand, a good tight knot. There. A pup pays nothing. A grown gnoll pays double.

show.journal: Show the pup's pack collar to Elder Grawl.
show.says: Good. Now you wear the pack's mark, and the pack will know you by sight as I know you by scent.

L2.name: Bound to the Burrow
offer: A gnoll who falls far from the pack is lost to it. Have Spiritmaster Rakk bind your spirit to the burrow, so that you wake here when you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Skulk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then do not stray past the fence, pup.
L2.started: Rakk is a few steps east of here. Skulk waits on the road outside the south-east gate.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Rakk, a few steps east of the elder, bind your spirit to the burrow.
bind.says: It is done. Fall where you will, pup: you wake here, with the pack's fire in your nose. Now go and give Coachman Skulk your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Skulk, on the road outside the south-east gate, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A pup for the ledger. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. The burrow holds your spirit, and the road knows your name.
Skulk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Neriak is earned. Packleader Varg, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Badgers on the Hill
offer: So you are the pup. Hrr. The hill badgers are digging under our fence from the north-west, and a badger hole breaks a guard's leg as well as a spear does.
Hunt them on the hill and bring me three pelts. Then I will teach you something worth your teeth.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: A pup that will not hunt is a pup that does not eat.
L3.started: Three pelts. Out the north gate and up the hill to the north-west. They bite low.

drop.name: hill badger pelt
drop.description: The striped pelt of a hill badger from the hill north-west of Blackburrow.

hunt.journal: Take three hill badger pelts from the hill badgers on the hill north-west of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring three hill badger pelts to Packleader Varg.
give.says: Three pelts, and your own still on you. Good hunting, pup. Now watch me, and learn this.

L4.name: A Pup's Arms
offer: Teeth are for pups. The dark elves want hunters who carry steel. I will make you proper gear, but you fetch what I need.
Hidescraper Yipp has a leather strip and a shaft for me. Then take a fang from the ridge vipers in the scrub south of the fence.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then gnaw on what you catch, and catch little.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Yipp, a fang from the vipers. Run, pup.

materials.journal: Ask Hidescraper Yipp for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Varg? Here. A strip of good hide and a straight shaft. Tell him the next badger pelt is mine.

drop.name: ridge viper fang
drop.description: The hooked fang of a ridge viper from the scrub south of Blackburrow.

hunt.journal: Take a ridge viper fang from the ridge vipers in the scrub south of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the ridge viper fang to Packleader Varg.
give.says: All three. Hold still... there. The fang's venom is in the edge now. It is yours. Do not lick it.

L5.name: Greymuzzle
offer: One hunt more, pup. An old wolf we call Greymuzzle has claimed the rise far to the north-east. He has pulled down two of our foragers, and he hunts alone, which makes him clever.
He will come for your throat the moment he smells you, so strike first. Bring me his fang, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a pup.
Will you hunt Greymuzzle?
L5.declined: He will still be hungry tomorrow.
L5.started: North-east, up on the rise. Come at him from downwind.

drop.name: Greymuzzle's fang
drop.description: A long yellow fang from the old wolf Greymuzzle.

hunt.journal: Take Greymuzzle's fang from the old wolf Greymuzzle on the rise far north-east of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring Greymuzzle's fang to Packleader Varg.
says: Greymuzzle's own fang! The foragers will howl your name tonight. You are a pup no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Brindle at the south-east gate when you are ready for Neriak.

flight.name: The Road to Neriak
offer: The dark elves of Neriak have use for gnolls with sharp noses and sharper teeth, and they treat the pack fairly enough. Varg says you are ready.
You have earned the road, pup. I will set you down among your own guild in Neriak, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Neriak?
flight.declined: Neriak will keep. The dark elves are not going anywhere.
flight.started: Hunt well, and keep your nose to the wind!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Brindle when you are ready to go to Neriak.

L7.name: The Snow's Scent
offer: Hrr. You are no pup now, and a hunter of the pack must know every scent of the Homelands. The cold has scents of its own.
Ride Skulk's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The badgers there dig through the snow east of the hunters' outpost. Bring me three of their pelts.
Will you learn the snow's scent?
L7.declined: Your nose will not grow keener by the fire.
L7.started: Skulk's coach will take you. Hunt downwind.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the three snowfield badger pelts to Packleader Varg.
give.says: Three pelts, and the snow still on them. Hrr, I smell the Eyrie on you. Now watch me, hunter, and learn this.

L10.name: A Colder Venom
offer: A hunter needs better teeth than a pup. The rime spiders of the Eyrie carry a venom colder than the ridge vipers' ever was.
Bring me two of their fangs, from the spiders north-east of the outpost, whole, and I will make you a weapon fit for a hunter of the pack.
Will you bring me the fangs?
L10.started: North-east of the outpost. Mind their bite, and keep the fangs whole.

drop.name: rime spider fang
drop.description: A fang of clear, frosted chitin from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two rime spider fangs from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the two rime spider fangs to Packleader Varg.
give.says: Whole, both of them. Hold still... the cold venom is in it now. It is yours. Still, do not lick it.

L13.name: Frostjaw's Fang
offer: Hrr. The outpost's hunters whine of an old snow leopard, Old Frostjaw, on the slopes north-east of the outpost. A cat that old is clever, as Greymuzzle was.
A pack hunts together. Take friends from the other homes, bring him down, and bring me his fang to hang beside Greymuzzle's.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.declined: Cats sleep long. He will keep.
L13.started: Hunt him as a pack. He strikes first.

drop.name: Old Frostjaw's fang
drop.description: A long yellowed fang of the snow leopard Old Frostjaw.

hunt.journal: Take Old Frostjaw's fang from the old snow leopard on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring Old Frostjaw's fang to Packleader Varg.
give.says: Frostjaw's own fang, to hang beside Greymuzzle's. The burrow will howl your name again tonight. Learn this.

L15.name: The Thing With No Scent
offer: Something walks the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost that has no scent at all. The hunters call it the Rimeheart. No blood, no breath. My hackles rise.
Break it, and bring me a shard of it. I want to know what a thing with no scent is made of.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then it walks on, and the game flees the snow.
L15.started: Go with the pack. The caves are colder than the snow.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Packleader Varg.
give.says: Hrr. Ice that never melts, and it smells of nothing. The pack will speak of this hunt a long time. Learn this.

L20.name: The Pack's Run
offer: Varg says you hunt like a grown gnoll now. Every hunter of Blackburrow runs once with the other homes at the Eyrie, so they learn the pack's scent.
Go to Scout Feyla, who watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the frozen river. Do as she asks, then come home to me and choose your path.
Will you run with the homes?
L20.declined: The run waits for those who are ready.
L20.started: Run well, and come home to the fire.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: A gnoll of Blackburrow? Good, I could use a nose. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Bring me three, and they will not raid the river again this winter.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three talons. Your nose found them faster than my eyes would have. Go home, hunter: your elder waits by the fire.

final.journal: Return to Elder Grawl in Blackburrow.
final.says: Hrrn. You smell of snow and blood and the other homes. You left a pup and came home a hunter of the pack. One thing more, then.

L20.picked: Hrr. Then it is yours. Carry it with the pack's pride.
